purpose: Static source-to-authority audit artifact, not a runtime rule database.
text_convention: Texts are exact source substrings, including embedded line breaks. Bullet prefixes may be excluded. Retained entries explicitly carry the identical destination text. Fragment entries split conditions or exceptions without changing their enclosing rule.
inheritance: Every obligation inherits source_path, source_sha256, scope, consumers, fixture_status and evidence from its document. A destination_id resolves to the exact destination_path, anchor and text in destinations. Retained obligations supply destination_anchor and destination_text and retain source_path as destination_path. requires_path is the document's required_delivery path to the destination owner; self-retained entries use its first element only. All evidence is unexecuted.
consumers: Author and each independent reviewer, separately, whenever the existing phase/task/path selection applies. No shared read acknowledgement substitutes for independent delivery.

fixture_status.reason: Main authorized a pre-execution extension with 27 fixed semantic cases covering all six manual_cases families. IDs identify proposed coverage using the same before/after oracle; they are not execution, parity or approval evidence.

evidence.authorized_work: Source reads, baseline archive hashes and document edits only; no validation, tests, build, lint, formatter or evaluation execution.

manual_cases.normal: A common error appears once globally and the feature does not render it locally.
manual_cases.violating: The same failure is both globally presented and placed in feature-local error state.
manual_cases.exception: A product-classified local Forbidden/403 stays local and does not reset navigation.

manual_cases.normal: Stable semantic key deduplicates pending and handling occurrences; confirmation enters handling before recovery and consumes after success.
manual_cases.violating: Consumption before recovery loses the error when navigation fails or is cancelled.
manual_cases.exception: A new semantic occurrence may reappear; failed/cancelled recovery may return to pending or retain explicit retryable failure state.

manual_cases.normal: Queue survives collector pause within its declared owner lifetime.
manual_cases.violating: An in-memory queue is claimed to guarantee process restart or external side-effect delivery.
manual_cases.exception: Product-required restart recovery defines persistence/replay/idempotency separately; UI-free server requires no UI queue.

manual_cases.normal: Supplied code/title/message/requestId survives conversion, queue and common UI; Clean port uses shared-presentation-contract.
manual_cases.violating: Transport exception leaks into Clean presentation or interceptor renders global UI.
manual_cases.exception: Local selected ownership/representation rules apply without adding a prescribed folder/module/wrapper.

manual_cases.normal: Android root stack, iOS path/coordinator and adopted RN router recover to login; React replaces current history and guards protected Back entries.
manual_cases.violating: Protected authenticated routes remain reachable; feature owns root reset; web history replacement is treated as authorization.
manual_cases.exception: Absent maintenance flow needs no invented route; existing UIKit coordinator, isolated RN mini-app and supported route-local framework responses remain valid.

manual_cases.normal: Each selected platform adapter requires app-shell-error-contract; Clean alone adds core.
manual_cases.violating: Local selection receives forced Clean ownership, or a platform adapter lacks its shared contract.
manual_cases.exception: Ordinary feature-local state selects matching presentation guidance rather than this capability; Next trusted-server auth guidance is conditional.

classification.text: `notify(error) == true` means AppShell owns the common error and the feature does not also render it locally.

classification-local.text: `notify(error) == false` means the feature owns the local inline error state.

classification-exception.text: Common errors include `SessionExpired`, `Maintenance`, `Forbidden`, and product-defined server-wide codes such as `COMMON_*` unless the product flow explicitly classifies one locally.

queue-start.text: On user confirmation, move the current error from `pending` to `handling` before starting the AppShell side effect.

queue-success.text: Move `handling` to `consumed` only after the navigation, root-flow, or maintenance side effect succeeds.

queue-retry.text: If the side effect fails or is cancelled, return the error to `pending` or retain an explicit retryable failure state. Never lose the recovery opportunity.

ownership.text: Features emit common-error intents and keep local errors in feature state; data/network/interceptor layers never present UI or reset navigation.

mapping.text:
In Clean mode, data mappers convert network/server failures into domain errors
  while preserving shared metadata; presentation mappers project them into
  feature-local or common-error UI values. Local mode uses the selected
  contract's representation boundaries while preserving the same metadata and
  UI ownership. These are semantic roles, not required wrapper or class names.

review.text:
Apply the same request-changes policy to any violation of the classification,
deduplication, acknowledgement, retry, or metadata rules above.

review-double.text: Request changes when classification can render the same failure both globally and locally, deduplication can double-show it, acknowledgement can lose it before recovery succeeds, or metadata disappears.

test-classification.text:
Feature tests must prove common errors notify AppShell rather than also becoming
feature-local error state.

test-once.text:
A common error appears once in the global host without
duplicate local rendering; a feature-local error remains local.

test-retry.text: Tests must cover common-versus-local classification, stable-key deduplication, `pending → handling → consumed`, failure/cancellation returning to a retryable state, and metadata preservation.

crash-boundary.text: Do not use crash handling or render fallback boundaries as the main API/domain common error handler.

completion.text: Use only the markers supplied by the active phase.

required-contract.text: Apply this semantic contract before the matching platform AppShell skill. Platform skills own host placement and navigation APIs; this file owns classification, queue, acknowledgement, and metadata meaning.

documents.scope: App-wide error handling on selected Android/iOS/Flutter/React Web/React Native scope. Shared semantics apply across modes; ownership/representation Clean clauses only in Clean, local selected contract exceptions remain adjacent.
